message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a beige background. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" is partially obscured by a large human profile. Below it, small red capital letters read "ENAK DIBACA DAN P...".

A large, light-skinned male profile in a blue shirt faces left. He has black hair, a prominent rounded nose, and closed eyes. His torso is cut away to reveal a circular cockpit interior. Inside, a smaller man with dark hair and a light grey shirt sits at a control panel, gripping two joysticks. A monitor behind him shows a white jagged line on a dark screen. The cockpit is framed by a curved yellow-brown structure with dark rivets.

Text on the left includes: "CAWE-CAWE SETELAH PENCOBLOSAN," followed by a paragraph of Indonesian text. The bottom left corner shows "26 FEBRUARI-3 MARET 2024," a price of "RP 50.000," website information, a barcode, and a QR code. Top headlines read: "Pembesar di Balik Sengketa Tambang Nikel H.66" and "Kembalinya Rezim Kuota Impor Daging H.78."
